treatment_summary: The plan addresses metabolic syndrome by initiating atorvastatin for lipid control, metformin for pre‑diabetes (contingent on eGFR ≥30), and a GLP‑1 RA (semaglutide) for weight loss if thyroid and pancreatitis screens are negative. Naproxen is stopped due to renal and cardiovascular risk and replaced with paracetamol. Existing antihypertensives (lisinopril and hydrochlorothiazide) are continued, with a possible HCTZ dose reduction if glucose control worsens. Diphenhydramine is reviewed for deprescribing. Baseline labs (eGFR, LFTs, lipid panel, thyroid history) and QRISK calculation are required before starting new agents. Monitoring includes lipid profile at 3 months, HbA1c every 6 months, BP each visit, renal function annually, and weight/BMI every visit. Non‑pharmacological measures (diet, exercise, structured weight‑loss programme, smoking cessation) are also recommended.
